title: "Customised scatter"
description: "Point colour, size, transparency and axis limits."
date: 2026-01-03
categories: [scatter, customisation]

---

```{python}
#| label: fig-customised-scatter
#| fig-alt: "Customised scatter plot"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import soundscapy as sspy

data = sspy.isd.load_demo()

sspy.scatter(
    data,
    title="Customised scatter plot",
    diagonal_lines=True,
    color="darkred",
    s=30,
    alpha=0.7,
    xlim=(-1.2, 1.2),
    ylim=(-1.2, 1.2),
)
plt.show()
```
